title: Nationalized Banks
definition: Commercial banks whose majority ownership (51% or more) and control have been acquired by the Central Government of India through specific legislative enactments to subserve national socio-economic objectives.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding historical phases of nationalization, statutory frameworks, and post-2019 mega-mergers. In Mains (GS Paper III - Economy), nationalized banks form the bedrock of financial inclusion, priority sector lending (PSL), and credit delivery to agriculture and MSMEs.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Nationalized Banks.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: History of planned economic development in India
